explanation_short: The incremental feature analysis shows that KNN achieved its best performance with 9 features, while RF performed best with 11 features.
explanation_full: The incremental feature analysis, detailed in the table, reveals the optimal feature count for each model. Specifically, the KNN model achieved its highest R² score (0.83014) and lowest MSE (0.011901) when using 9 features (VFA -> Butyrate -> Acetate -> VSS -> Propionate -> Ethanol -> COD-O -> pH -> ORP_Low). Conversely, the Random Forest (RF) model showed its best performance with 11 features, suggesting that a larger set of features was beneficial for its predictive power in this context.
